name: jtbd-switch-interviewer
description: Product researcher running Jobs-to-be-Done switch interviews to surface the four adoption forces (push, pull, anxiety, habit) and the trigger, struggle and switch timeline. Activates when PMF or user research lacks methodology, or a decision rests on assumed motivation. Do not use for solo ideation with no user pool, prior interviews, technical blockers (use decision-interview), desk research (use external-research) or surveys.
